html:
Didier Ratsiraka was a naval officer who ruled Madagascar from 1975 to 1993 and again from 1997 to 2002.

After the fall of Tsiranana he took power in 1975, set out his socialist programme in a little red book, nationalised banks and firms, and turned to the Soviet bloc and North Korea. French bases were closed. Debt and shortages followed, and in the 1980s he turned to the IMF.

Protests forced him from power in 1993. He returned by election in 1997, but after the disputed election of 2001 a long standoff with Marc Ravalomanana split the country, and he went into exile in France in 2002. That crisis foreshadowed the crisis of 2009 in Madagascar.
sum: Didier Ratsiraka was a naval officer who ruled Madagascar from 1975 to 1993 and again from 1997 to 2002.
